title: GST Registration Cancellation Made Easier: Rule 20 Substituted from Dec 1, 2026
content:
# GST Registration Cancellation Made Easier: Rule 20 Substituted from Dec 1, 2026

Ek important update hai! Government ne GST Registration Cancellation ke Rule 20 mein significant changes announce kiye hain, jisse ab process aur bhi streamlined ho jayega.

Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) ne **Notification No. 08/2026–Central Tax** dated November 25, 2026, issue kiya hai, jisse Central Goods and Services Tax (Second Amendment) Rules, 2026, effective honge.

**Key Highlights of the Update:**

*   **Notification Number and Date:** Notification No. 08/2026–Central Tax, dated November 25, 2026.
*   **Effective Date:** Ye changes **December 1, 2026** se लागू honge.
*   **Rule Substituted:** CGST Rules, 2017 ke Rule 20 ke sub-rules (5) aur (6) ko substitute kiya gaya hai.

**What's New in GST Registration Cancellation (Rule 20)?**

*   **Easier Automatic Cancellation:** Ab agar aapne cancellation application file ki hai, aur Rule 20(2) and (3) ke under saare returns time par submit kar diye hain, aur sabhi dues (tax, interest, fee, penalty, ya koi bhi other amount) pay kar diye hain, toh common portal aapki registration automatically cancel kar dega electronically in FORM GST REG-38.
*   **Conditions Removed:** Pehle jo additional conditions thi jaise ki monthly output tax liability ₹2.5 lakh se zyada na ho, ya GSTR-10 teen din ke andar file kiya ho, unhe ab hata diya gaya hai. Iska matlab hai ki ab automatic cancellation, business ke turnover size se affect nahi hoga.
*   **Officer Intervention:** Agar returns ya FORM GST CMP-08 statements (jahan applicable ho) furnish nahi kiye gaye hain, ya koi bhi amount payable remain unpaid hai, toh application proper officer ko examination ke liye forward ki jayegi.

Yeh amendment voluntary GST registration cancellation process ko aur liberalize karta hai, making it more technology-driven and simplifying compliance.
